format: Synthetic normalized investigation export; see data dictionary
management_events: All reads and writes in the fictional account during the observation period
s3_data_events: GetObject coverage on all prefixes of harborcart-documents-synthetic; enabled before the incident
s3_server_logs: Matching object access records supplied; duplicates possible; production delivery is best effort
host: Normalized endpoint process/request context, metadata category and scheduler observations; no full command arguments or payloads
network: Selected ENI VPC flow records, network metadata only. Metadata-service traffic is represented only by host telemetry.
limitations: HTTP request bodies and exact vulnerable code not supplied
S3 object contents and record/person counts not supplied
No logs beyond the stated observation window
No evidence about resources outside the covered account and bucket
A successful response does not prove the recipient retained or redistributed the bytes
